value.rationale: The published circular-PIT independence criterion is only necessary outside its special joining-density model; the new theorem identifies the entire obstruction even to observing sum and difference jointly, gives its first possible spectral degree, and exhibits exact finite-sample blindness for a smooth positively quadrant-dependent alternative with explicit nonzero rank correlations.
